sources.excerpt: REMEDY / GERMANIUM FUZZ — GREENHOUSE EFFECTS Skip to Content Open Menu Close Menu GREENHOUSE EFFECTS SHOP PEDALS MERCH DEALERS ABOUT CONTACT THE STORY 0 0 GREENHOUSE EFFECTS SHOP PEDALS MERCH DEALERS ABOUT CONTACT THE STORY 0 0 Open Menu Close Menu Folder: SHOP Back PEDALS MERCH DEALERS Folder: ABOUT Back CONTACT THE STORY PEDALS › REMEDY / GERMANIUM FUZZ Image 1 of 1 REMEDY / GERMANIUM FUZZ $199.00 sold out When it comes to fuzz, it's all about character.And this fuzz has a unique and distinctive one. A blend of silicon and germanium transistors pushed to near melting point, creates a variety of intense and powerful fuzz tones, from 60s psychedelic garage fuzz to extreme uncompromising stoner growl. The health knob has a dramatic effect on the way this pedal acts and sounds. Fully clockwise, the fuzz is at its best shape - aggressive , jumpy and loud. Turn the health down and make it sweat - this fuzz sounds crazier as it struggle to fight back. Finally it submits and delivers a sweet gargle, making your guitar sound like a disrupted brass instrument. Sold Out Added!
